names_for.catalogue_side: Ready Made Datasets (vaisual.com); pre-made dataset products in the Dataset Shop
names_for.custom_side: custom datasets you create (Create Dataset in the shop); customization work and custom shoots via Request A Quote (vaisual.com)

operator_role.note: vAIsual, Inc. grants the licence itself, including for collections licensed in from third parties such as Panther Media.

economics_model.note: Principal margin on its own shoots; licensed-in third-party collections are paid by a royalty share on sales (percentage not published).

who_pays_fee.note: No marketplace fee: vAIsual sells as licensor at its own list prices.

supply_models.note: Own biometric shoots plus collections licensed in from stock agencies and content owners (Panther Media, Wirestock.io).

custody_model.note: Buyer downloads the dataset: within 30 days of a one-time purchase, up to three downloads a month.

transaction_mode.note: Listed resolutions are bought through a Purchase flow; full resolution and custom work go through contact / quote.

public_prices.note: Per-image grid and per-listing prices are public; some tiers (full resolution on some listings) are contact-only.

licence_model.note: Standard vs Extended (generative visual synthetic media), each as one-time purchase or annual subscription, plus a RAIL for models.

exclusivity_offered.note: Listed datasets are licensed non-exclusively under the published EULA; exclusive material is mentioned only for custom shoots. Whether a listed dataset can be bought exclusively is not published.

public_listing.note: Listings with prices, licence options, sample thumbnails and model release PDFs were readable without login.

buyer_vetting.note: Account required and approved at vAIsual's discretion; UK entities and Russia treated as restricted by FAQ.

sample_mechanics.note: About 10 sample images per dataset; whether download needs a login was not tested (no sign-ups).

versioning.note: A listing is a growing dataset: subscribers receive monthly additions, one-time buyers keep the snapshot; no version numbers seen.

human_subject_consent_docs.note: The blank release template (adult and minor, V7) is downloadable from the listing; individual signed releases are not shown to buyers.

contributor_pay_model.note: Depicted models are paid a fee at the shoot and waive further payment; content owners who supply collections get a royalty share per sale.

erasure_after_sale.note: Buyers must delete on EULA termination; no clause found obliging buyers to delete images when a model withdraws consent (the release obliges only vAIsual).

quality_evidence.note: vAIsual reviews supplied files before inclusion and writes the listing itself, including a metadata tolerance caveat; no third-party quality evidence.

Q1.answer: The shop targets ML developers, data scientists and AI researchers and charges per dataset, priced per image by resolution and use; it treats UK entities as a risk. No buyer counts, volumes or reasons for buying off-the-shelf were found.

Q2.answer: Content owners and agencies hand collections to vAIsual, which reviews, packages and sells them for a royalty share; Wirestock framed it as a new way for its contributors to monetise. No provider-side comparison with building its own store was found.

Q3.answer: Inventory is vAIsual's own consented biometric shoots plus collections licensed in from stock agencies and content owners (Panther Media, Wirestock), who must hold releases and rights.

Q4.answer: The supplier guide warns that work shot for a commercial client may belong to the client and so cannot be licensed. No case of relisting commissioned custom work or of retroactive term changes was found.

Q5.answer: vAIsual, Inc. is licensor of record under a Delaware-law EULA, indemnifies buyers against IP infringement claims and caps liability at fees paid; the EULA itself contains no consent warranty.

Q6.answer: Buyers download a copy: within 30 days of a one-time purchase and up to three downloads a month.

Q7.answer: Depicted people sign a biometric release licensable to third parties, can withdraw (repaying fees within 2 years) and withdrawal means deletion by vAIsual; suppliers must hold releases and agencies are told to get contributor opt-in. Property and landmark clearance is only flagged.

Q8.answer: Non-exclusive, non-transferable licence with no publication, audit on 10 days' notice, and deletion plus a signed Data Deletion Acknowledgement on termination; generative use needs the Extended licence. No fingerprinting or watermarking was found.

Q9.answer: Self-serve purchase via Stripe (card or bank transfer) at published prices, with contact for full resolution and a quote for custom work; vAIsual owns or licenses in the inventory and pays suppliers a royalty share.

Q10.answer: A listing is a dataset sold per resolution under one-time (snapshot, perpetual) or subscription (monthly additions) terms; custom compiled datasets have no subscription. No revision numbers or withdrawal policy for past buyers were found.

Q11.answer: Buyers see free 10-image samples, thumbnails, demographic breakdowns and the model release template, and the listing states metadata tolerance; vAIsual reviews supplier files before inclusion.

Q12.answer: The off-the-shelf side is 'Ready Made Datasets' / pre-made products in the Dataset Shop, where buyers can also compile custom datasets; bespoke shoots and customization go through a quote, with exclusivity priced in.
